Brush Rigging and Collector Rings 
 Inspection

The collector brush rigging should be cleaned 
 by using brushes air blower

Check the side clearance between brush 
 and brushes holder

Inspect all nuts bolts and capscrews for 
 tightness

Check the clearance between brush holder and 
 collector ring

Check the brush wear brush tap 
 at least 1/8" above top of brush box
Remove the brushes from their holders

Clean brush and holder so brush may move 
 freely

Use a soft brush seating stone or a canvas - 
 padded bort to remove excess film from shaft

Replace brushes before the pigtail is in 
 contact with top of brush box
Check the connection of wiring of board

Check the Calibration of the temperature 
 meter

Test resistance of all resistance temperature 
 detectors ( R.T.D ) it should be 11.73 W

Check sight glasses after level detectors for liquid level.
 Check gas consumption.

Check hydrogen cooler vent.
 Check shaft-grounding brushes.
 Check carbon brushes.
 Check seal oil cooler in operation for proper venting.
 Check seal oil supply lines and shut off valves for leakage.
 Check degree of contamination of seal oil filter.
 Check oil level and contamination of oil in vacuum pump.
 Drain liquid from drain traps before and after vacuum pump.

Change over seal oil 
 pump 1&2.
 Perform functional 
 check of stand by seal oil pump.
 Change over vapor 
 exhausters 1&2.
 Check intake 
 strainer in take port of vacuum pump.
 Check exhaust filter 
 at vacuum pump.
 Re-grease shaft seal 
 of vapor of exhauster.
Check air filter at fan motor of gas dryer on dirt.

Check exciter end generator bearing and shaft 
 seal insulation.
 Re-greasing devices of vapor exhauster shaft 
 seals with grease.
 Drain liquid from compressed air filter.
 Check slip ring surface. (At rotor standstill)

Measure insulation resistance.
 Check shut off valve of gas supply for function 
 and free movement.
 Check gas supply line, shut off valves and 
 solenoids on gas tightness.
